title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement

---

**Problem statement**

What problem are you trying to solve? Describe the pain point, not a
solution. Semantic Runtime's scope is deliberately narrow (semantic
understanding, context resolution, evidence, safe execution); see the
[PRD](https://github.com/Chloride233/semantic-runtime/blob/main/docs/Semantic%20Runtime%20PRD.md)
for what it is and is not.

**Proposed behavior**

A description of how you imagine the feature working.

**Alternatives considered**

What alternatives you evaluated, if any.

**Relevant design documents**

Links to any docs under `docs/` this feature touches.
